Class TotemPlacedEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.UpdateEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.TotemPlacedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TotemPlacedEvent extends UpdateEvent
Event representing a player placing their totem on a specific track card. Inherits from UpdateEvent. This event is generated when the turn order is being decided and the player chooses a position.

  • Constructor Details

    • TotemPlacedEvent

      public TotemPlacedEvent(String playerNickname, char trackCardName, int gameId, int numFood, String first)
      Constructs a TotemPlacedEvent triggered by the server when a player successfully places their totem.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who placed the totem.
      trackCardName - the character identifier of the track card where the totem was placed.
      gameId - the unique ID of the game (used only for server-side bufferization).
      numFood - the updated amount of food possessed by the player.
      first - the nickname of the player who became first in the turn order (if applicable).

    • TotemPlacedEvent

      public TotemPlacedEvent(String description, String playerNickname, char trackCardName, int numFood, String first)
      Constructs a TotemPlacedEvent from JSON data, used by Jackson upon receiving a message.
      Parameters:
      description - the description of the event.
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who placed the totem.
      trackCardName - the character identifier of the chosen track card.
      numFood - the updated amount of food for the player.
      first - the nickname of the first player in the new turn order (if any).
